sources.title: Kim Go-eun, Gang Dong-won to star in new Netflix series
Gang Dong-won, Kim Go-eun to Star in Netflix’s ‘The Twilight Between Us’ From ‘When Life Gives You Tangerines’ Director, ‘Queen of Tears’ Writer

en.title: Kim Go-eun and Gang Dong-won to star in Netflix series The Twilight Between Us
en.dek: Netflix announced the historical romance drama The Twilight Between Us, featuring Kim Go-eun and Gang Dong-won in their first collaboration.
facts: Netflix announced the series The Twilight Between Us on 12 November 2026.
Kim Go-eun plays Su-ryeon, the daughter of the Han family.
Gang Dong-won portrays Mu-yeong, an illegitimate son of the Kang family.
Park Ji-eun wrote the drama, and Kim Won-suk directed it.
body: Yonhap reported that actors Kim Go-eun and Gang Dong-won were cast in the upcoming historical romance drama, The Twilight Between Us, on 12 November 2026.
The series follows Mu-yeong and Su-ryeon, whose families have feuded for a century, and the king arranged the match to end the hostility, according to Variety.
Kim plays Su-ryeon, the Han family's only daughter, who is compelled to marry Mu-yeong after failing to become crown princess, Yonhap stated.
Gang portrays Mu-yeong, an illegitimate son of the Kang family, who has excellent martial arts skills and a noble mind, Variety reported.
en.context: Park Ji-eun wrote the drama, which includes previous works such as Queen of Tears in 2024, and Kim Won-suk directed it, known for Signal (2016) and My Mister (2018), according to the sources.

pt.title: Kim Go-eun e Gang Dong-won estrelam a série da Netflix The Twilight Between Us
pt.dek: A Netflix anunciou o drama romântico histórico The Twilight Between Us, com Kim Go-eun e Gang Dong-won na sua primeira colaboração.
facts: A Netflix anunciou a série The Twilight Between Us a 12 de novembro de 2026.
Kim Go-eun interpreta Su-ryeon, filha da família Han.
Gang Dong-won interpreta Mu-yeong, filho ilegítimo da família Kang.
Park Ji-eun escreveu o drama e Kim Won-suk dirigiu-o.
body: Yonhap informou que os atores Kim Go-eun e Gang Dong-won foram escalados para o drama romântico histórico em breve, The Twilight Between Us, em 12 de novembro de 2026.
A série segue Mu-yeong e Su-ryeon, cujas famílias têm um século de rivalidade, e o rei arranjou o casamento para pôr fim à hostilidade, segundo a Variety.
Kim interpreta Su-ryeon, a única filha da família Han, que é forçada a casar-se com Mu-yeong após falhar em se tornar princesa coroada, afirmou a Yonhap.
Gang retrata Mu-yeong, filho ilegítimo da família Kang, que possui excelentes habilidades marciais e uma mente nobre, segundo a Variety.
pt.context: Park Ji-eun escreveu o drama, que inclui trabalhos anteriores como Queen of Tears em 2024, e Kim Won-suk dirigiu-o, conhecido por Signal (2016) e My Mister (2018), segundo as fontes.

zh.title: 金姬恩与姜东旻将主演Netflix系列剧《暮光之间》
zh.dek: Netflix宣布制作历史爱情剧《暮光之间》，金姬恩与姜东旻将合作出演，这是两人首度合作。
facts: Netflix于2026年11月12日宣布制作系列剧《暮光之间》
金姬恩在剧中饰演韩家千金素连
姜东旻饰演康家非婚生子武永
朴智恩编剧，金元熙执导
body: 韩联社报道，演员金姬恩和姜东旻将出演即将于2026年11月12日在Netflix上播出的古装浪漫剧《暮光之间》。
据《Variety》报道，该剧讲述了穆英和苏涟的家族世代恩怨已达百年，而国王为平息敌对关系而安排了他们的结合。
韩联社称，金姬恩饰演韩家唯一的女儿苏涟，因未能成为王储后被迫嫁给穆英。
《Variety》报道，姜东旻饰演康家的庶子穆英，他武艺高强，心性高贵。
zh.context: 朴智恩曾执笔2024年剧集《泪之女王》，金元熙则以执剧《Signal》（2016）和《我的 Mister》（2018）而闻名，据消息来源称。

de.title: Kim Go-eun und Gang Dong-won für Netflix-Serie „The Twilight Between Us“
de.dek: Netflix gab die historische Romanze „The Twilight Between Us“ bekannt, in der Kim Go-eun und Gang Dong-won erstmals zusammenwirken.
facts: Netflix gab die Serie „The Twilight Between Us“ am 12. November 2026 bekannt.
Kim Go-eun spielt Su-ryeon, die Tochter der Familie Han.
Gang Dong-won porträtiert Mu-yeong, einen unehelichen Sohn der Familie Kang.
Park Ji-eun schrieb das Drama, Kim Won-suk führte die Regie.
body: Yonhap berichtete, dass die Schauspieler Kim Go-eun und Gang Dong-won in der kommenden historischen Liebesdramaserie „The Twilight Between Us“ am 12. November 2026 casten wurden.
Die Serie handelt von Mu-yeong und Su-ryeon, deren Familien seit einem Jahrhundert zerstritten sind, und der König arrangierte die Heirat, um die Feindschaft zu beenden, so Variety.
Kim spielt Su-ryeon, die einzige Tochter der Han-Familie, die gezwungen ist, sich mit Mu-yeong zu verheiraten, nachdem sie es nicht geschafft hat, Kronprinzessin zu werden, teilte Yonhap mit.
Gang verkörpert Mu-yeong, einen außerehelichen Sohn der Kang-Familie, der ausgezeichnete Kampfkünste und einen edlen Geist besitzt, berichtete Variety.
de.context: Park Ji-eun schrieb das Drama, das vorherige Werke wie „Queen of Tears“ aus dem Jahr 2024 umfasst, und Kim Won-suk führte die Regie, bekannt für „Signal“ (2016) und „My Mister“ (2018), wie die Quellen berichten.

ko.title: 김고은·강동원, 넷플릭스 시리즈 '우리 사이의 황혼' 출연
ko.dek: 넷플릭스가 김고은과 강동원의 첫 협업작인 시대극 로맨스 드라마 '우리 사이의 황혼'을 발표했다.
facts: 넷플릭스는 2026년 11월 12일 시리즈 '우리 사이의 황혼' 발표
김고은은 한씨 가문의 딸 수련 역을 맡는다
강동원은 강씨 가문의 사생아 무영 역을 맡는다
드라마는 박지은이 집필하고 김원석이 연출했다
body: 연합뉴스에 따르면 배우 김고은과 강동원이 2026년 11월 12일 공개될 넷플릭스 시대극 로맨스 드라마 '우리 사이의 황혼'에 출연한다.
버라이어티에 따르면 이 시리즈는 100년간 가족 간의 불화가 이어져 온 무영과 수련의 이야기를 다루며, 왕이 이 갈등을 끝내기 위해 두 사람의 정략결혼을 주선한다.
연합뉴스에 의하면 김고은은 왕세자비가 되지 못한 한씨 가문의 외동딸 수련 역을 맡는다.
버라이어티는 강동원이 뛰어난 무예 실력과 고결한 마음을 지닌 강씨 가문의 사생아 무영 역을 맡는다고 전했다.
ko.context: 소식통에 따르면, 박지은은 2024년 '눈물의 여왕' 등의 작품을 집필했으며, 김원석은 '시그널'(2016)과 '나의 아저씨'(2018)로 알려져 있다.

problemsFixed: The headline is not a purely factual statement of what happened; it is a summary of casting.
The dek is not a single-sentence summary under 30 words.
The facts list is acceptable but needs refinement for conciseness.
The body paragraphs do not adhere to the rhythm requirement (varying sentence length, no four short declarative sentences in a row) and contain some repetition.
The context section incorrectly attributes the 'romance-action period piece' description solely to Yonhap, while Variety also provides this context.
The body sentences sometimes restate previous information without adding new data (e.g., the character descriptions).
